verdict.rationale: The open-source framework follows Semantic Versioning. Its changelog has explicit Deprecated sections that name removal targets (e.g. removal in 2.0.0), and a 1.0 migration guide confirms deprecations are staged before removal at the major version. However, the Pipecat Cloud REST API is versioned only by URL path (/v1) with no documented deprecation window, so the story is covered only for the framework. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy and window for the Cloud REST API, a formal standalone deprecation-policy page with guaranteed timelines, and independent corroboration of deprecation practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: this project adheres to Semantic Versioning
Pipecat 1.0 removes many deprecated APIs from the 0.0.x series. If you were already using the non-deprecated replacements, most of these changes won't affect you.
